groups.label: Stat and equipment weights
groups.help: A stat weight of 100 uses the full stat value. The target's weighted stats reduce the caster's contribution.

groups.label: Status and equipped skill weights
groups.help: Names follow the status and skill IDs configured in this project's row zero. These weights contribute to the percentage modifier. A weight of 1000 contributes 10%.

groups.label: Equipment element weights
groups.help: The main-hand block requires the weapon element to match the action element. The other blocks weight the corresponding equipment's elemental values.

groups.label: Element relationships
groups.help: These values are read from the caster's row. Action and caster weights use 100 for a 1× multiplier. Caster and target values contribute to the net percentage modifier.

groups.label: Additional stored values
groups.help: These values are shown for reference. The source of the extra action-element inputs and the role of the remaining stored words need further investigation.
